name: Swathi Arepalli
summary: Strategy and transformation leader with 11+ years at Accenture, EY-Parthenon and Deloitte and an INSEAD MBA. Works with C-suites and cross-functional teams in telecom, infrastructure, financial services and consumer businesses. Has acted as Business Analyst on a Salesforce migration (Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud) for a Southeast Asia client, designed customer loyalty and retention programmes, and built tools that turn customer data into action. Brings a B2B, data-led approach to customer adoption and revenue growth, and turns ambiguous problems into clear plans that stakeholders align behind.

experience.title: Team Leader, Strategy Consulting – Corporate Strategy, Portfolio & Partnerships
bullets: Acted as Business Analyst for a Southeast Asia client's migration onto Salesforce (Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud), carrying out the full range of BA work from requirements through to delivery with the project team.
Designed a customer loyalty programme that raised retention, deepened customer understanding and improved frontline team performance.
Created a CX Sensor that structures customer reviews, filters out noise and surfaces the feedback that matters so the business can act on it.

Set the long-term strategic direction and market positioning for a B2B client's digital portal by reviewing the platform, redefining how customers should interact with it and proposing the enhancements needed.
Built the growth strategy for an infrastructure client by selecting between organic and inorganic options, lifting enterprise value by close to 30% and setting revenue growth of 25% to 30%.
Rationalised the product portfolio of a leading regional telco across 10 entities and identified partnership strategies that opened new revenue streams.
Led the carve-out of a telecom operator with 13+ consolidated entities into separate B2C, B2B, ICT and wholesale segments, defining the target structure and the path to get there.

experience.title: Senior Consultant, Strategy – Product Strategy, Market Entry & Growth
bullets: Sized the opportunity and built the business plan for a $50M consumer market entry across Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines that won board approval.
Reset pricing, channel mix and trade incentives for a personal care brand which lifted modern trade share by 4 points and revenue by 12% in 12 months.
Developed a 5-year portfolio strategy for a $3B consumer products company that rationalised 25% of SKUs and prioritised 3 growth platforms behind a +180 bps margin plan.

experience.title: Consultant, Strategy – M&A, Due Diligence & Digital Strategy
bullets: Built the integration plan for two merging banks across 40+ workstreams and quantified $60M in cost synergies.
Benchmarked 15 fintech platforms to shape a digital growth strategy that secured executive committee approval for a $30M investment roadmap.

experience.title: Business Analyst – Market Research & Competitive Intelligence
bullets: Delivered 30+ market sizing and competitor studies for Fortune 500 technology and banking clients that informed pricing, launch and investment decisions.
